narrative_structure_25_35s.description: Wide clifftop overlooking daylight landscape with billowing cumulus clouds; wanderer in kasa and billowing haori; wind secondary motion.
Full-body rear tracking shot walking along mountain trail; walking cycle vertical bob, coat tails flapping, katana swaying.
Dynamic medium tracking gaze; petals swirl; wanderer detects curiosity point in the distance; subtle eye/head shift.
Close-up katana hilt and combat stance; thumb clicks golden tsuba open; steel slides out casting lens flare across narrowed eyes.
High-velocity combat slash; cyan and gold plasma crescent shockwave arcs; screen shake impact; speedlines burst.
Blade spin or landing motion; sliced cherry blossom petals drift past in slow-mo; character turns toward camera.
Low-angle 3/4 hero finish pose facing camera; hand resting on sheathed katana; radiant 8-point sunburst flare reflecting off horizon.
